notes.subject: wantaim ⟨את⟩ mi
notes.rationale: אתי here is H854 preposition 'with me', not the direct-object marker; gloss carries ⟨את⟩ per corpus convention.

notes.subject: to ol man harim
notes.rationale: Plural imperative summons hearers to join praise — the psalm's call to community.

notes.subject: גדלו / ונרוממה
notes.rationale: Paired verbs 'make great' and 'raise high' form a height-magnification pair, kept as 'bikpela' / 'salim i antap'.

translation: Yu olsem, kam na mekim Yahwe i kamap bikpela wantaim ⟨את⟩ mi, na yumi salim nem bilong em i antap wantaim.

tokens.gloss: Yu olsem, kam na mekim i kamap bikpela
